mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 0.2% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 0.2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate below 7% signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the unemployment rate is below 7% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and a decrease in the unemployment rate signal a strong demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when housing starts are increasing and the unemployment rate is decreasing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals a strong supply environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when industrial production is increasing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in the money supply signal an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is decreasing and the money supply is increasing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when payroll employment is above 130000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index and an increase in GDP growth rate signal a strong demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the consumer price index is decreasing and GDP growth rate is increasing (t-test p > 0.05).
